scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend/registry install && npm --prefix frontend/host install && npm --prefix frontend/remote1 install && npm --prefix frontend/remote2 install && npm --prefix frontend/shared-ui install && npm --prefix frontend/remote3 install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "@('.', 'frontend/registry', 'frontend/host', 'frontend/remote1', 'frontend/remote2', 'frontend/shared-ui', 'frontend/remote3') | ForEach-Object { $path = Join-Path $_ 'node_modules'; if (Test-Path $path) { Write-Host 'Removing '$path; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $path }; $lock = Join-Path $_ 'package-lock.json'; if (Test-Path $lock) { Write-Host 'Removing '$lock; Remove-Item -Force $lock } }"
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean && npm run install:all
scripts.dev: moon run host:dev remote1:dev remote2:dev remote3:dev shared-ui:dev
scripts.verify-contracts: moon run :typecheck && echo ✅ All contracts verified!
